tasks.short: Interpret pattern drawings, compute dimensions and plan operations

steps.what: Read and interpret casting or pattern drawings and verify dimension inputs
Compute repeated pattern dimensions using specified allowances and units
Verify dimensions and plan the actual patternmaking operational sequence

tasks.design: Test native dimension formulas in the pattern-design application in {OTHER}. Reuse specified allowances and units for repeated arithmetic, while the patternmaker interprets drawings, checks results and writes the operational plan in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated allowance arithmetic is mixed with interpretation and process planning.
tasks.enabler_now: Native formulas can reuse verified dimensions and explicitly selected allowances.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting allowances and planning a feasible sequence for the actual pattern.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise drawing ambiguities and practical machining constraints.
tasks.altitude: Less arithmetic with unchanged patternmaking judgement.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: pattern-design calculations can apply specified dimensional allowances; interpretation and selection of allowances remain skilled work.

assumptions: Provisional boundary covers drawing interpretation, dimension calculation and operational planning, not manufacturing release. OTHER is the pattern-design calculation application.

The patternmaker verifies drawing revision, nominal dimensions, units, material, selected shrinkage and machining allowances in s1. Drawing extraction and missing values remain manual there; no free normalized drawing input is assumed.

Native formulas are assessed first. Only 25 repeated arithmetic points are removed; existing calculation runtime earns no credit. s3 retains independent calculation checks, failed-input repair and actual plan writing and save. Excess repair lowers the estimate.
The operational plan is the task's existing plan for making the pattern, not a new activity log. Ordinary author saves remain ungated and fully retained.
research_questions: Compare manual allowance calculations and native formulas on an actual casting drawing.

incremental.description: Maintain unit and allowance calculation examples

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 25 arithmetic points less 1 upkeep. An ambiguous legacy drawing requires manual interpretation and bespoke allowances; automate only 5 points of compatible standard dimensions: 5 minus 1 = 4.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design and create templates, patterns and coreboxes

steps.what: Interpret orders, sample parts or mockups and design the pattern or corebox
outputs: pattern design and verified reusable geometry

steps.what: Copy verified repeat outlines and template features into the pattern design
inputs: pattern design and verified reusable geometry

steps.what: Physically create, fit and assemble the actual pattern, template or corebox
Check the completed pattern against the order and correct fit or geometry

tasks.design: Configure native reuse of verified outlines in the pattern CAD application in {OTHER}. It removes repeat copying only, retaining order interpretation, fresh geometry, physical pattern creation and complete fit checks.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated outline copying adds work even when the reusable shape is already verified.
tasks.enabler_now: Native geometry libraries can insert selected compatible outlines and features.
tasks.still_hard: Adapting a pattern to casting behaviour and physically achieving the intended fit.
tasks.human_edge: Judge shape, material behaviour and practical pattern quality.
tasks.altitude: Less copying with unchanged physical craft and design responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: CAD libraries can reuse verified pattern geometry, while creating and fitting physical patterns remains skilled work.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for patterns with actual repeat geometry. OTHER is the pattern CAD application. Entirely physical or unique-pattern workflows need reweighting without this benefit.

The patternmaker verifies source revision, feature IDs, scale, units and intended fit in s1. Sample-part measurement, missing digitisation and fresh geometry are retained there. No new scanning or upstream tracing is priced as free.

Native library reuse is tested first. Only 15 copying points are removed. s1/s4 retain incompatible-geometry repair, complete checks and ordinary design saves. Repair exceeding that allowance lowers the estimate.
No new completion log is imposed. Physical creation remains 40 points; no machine-control send or formal release is assumed.
research_questions: Try native reuse on a real pattern and count measurement, digitisation and fit repair.

incremental.description: Maintain verified library geometry and revision labels

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 15 copying points less 1 upkeep. A new freeform corebox shares only 3 points of verified standard outline features; keep fresh design and all physical work: 3 minus 1 = 2.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify pattern requirements and source specifications for wood, resin and fiberglass
Compare explicit material-property limits against verified candidate specifications
Inspect the actual available wood, resin or fiberglass condition
Select pattern materials using condition, process needs and practical experience

tasks.design: Test native filters in the material catalogue in {OTHER} for explicit, verified property limits. Use the comparison as reference only; the patternmaker still reads source specifications, inspects actual stock and selects wood, resin or fiberglass.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated property comparisons are mixed with practical material selection.
tasks.enabler_now: Catalogue filters can compare explicit fields without pretending to judge material condition.
tasks.still_hard: Knowing how the actual stock will machine, age and behave in the pattern process.
tasks.human_edge: Choose suitable material using inspection and craft experience.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated property lookup with unchanged material selection authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: material-catalogue filters can compare explicit specification fields, but physical condition and pattern suitability require practical judgement.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is material selection, not purchasing or inventory updates. OTHER is the material catalogue. No new selection log or purchase send is introduced.

Supplier specifications provide material ID, type, dimensions and relevant property values with units and source date. The patternmaker checks and manually completes these in s1; the design does not assume a new free materials database.

Native filters are assessed first. The 15 points removed are repeated explicit property comparisons, not final choice. Missing fields, unusual materials and filter repair remain s1/s4; an unstructured catalogue needs lower benefits or more capture effort.
Existing automatic filtering earns no labour credit. There is no separate record save or approval duty in this selection boundary.
research_questions: Test filters on the materials actually considered for one pattern and count missing fields.

incremental.description: Maintain property-field mappings and comparison examples

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 15 comparison points less 0.8 upkeep. An unusual resin has incomplete specifications; compare only 3 points of available dimensional and temperature fields, retaining the rest manually: 3 minus 0.8 = 2.2.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Program numerical control machine tools for patternmaking

steps.what: Verify pattern geometry, tooling, machine limits and programming requirements
Program the machine-tool paths, sequence and machining parameters
Enter repeated drilling-cycle and safe-retract blocks for specified operations
Simulate and safely validate the actual program and tool motion
Check the final program revision, machine identity and deployment conditions
Load the approved program into the specified machine controller

tasks.design: Configure native machining cycles in the programming application in {OTHER} to replace repeated block entry. Retain original toolpath choices, simulation, safe validation and final revision checks, then keep the actual controller load as its own gated action.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated cycle blocks are entered alongside bespoke machining logic.
tasks.enabler_now: Native cycles can expand explicitly selected parameters into repeat program blocks.
tasks.still_hard: Ensuring safe motion and suitable machining of the actual pattern material.
tasks.human_edge: Choose toolpaths and verify the program against the real setup.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated block entry with unchanged machine-programming authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: numerical-control programming tools support reusable machining cycles; the programmer still validates tool motion and the real machine setup.

assumptions: Provisional scenario includes manual repeated cycle-block entry. OTHER covers the programming application, simulator and machine controller. Existing automatic postprocessing runtime has no saving credit.

The patternmaker verifies units, work offsets, tool ID, geometry revision, cycle parameters and machine/postprocessor identity in s1-s2. Missing setup or incompatible cycles return to manual programming with retained correction work in s4-s5; excess repair lowers the estimate.
Native cycles are tested first. Only 15 repeated block-entry points are removed. Original programming, simulation, safe validation, final checking and ordinary file saves remain fully retained.

s5 binds the final validated revision and machine destination before the separate actual controller load. Any program or setup change voids approval. The controller load retains its small full time; no gate is imposed on ordinary author saves.
unknowns: Existing cycle use and actual repeated entry
research_questions: Validate native cycles on a real pattern program and count setup, repair and machine checks.

incremental.description: Maintain cycle compatibility and regression programs

approvals.approved_version: s5 exact validated program revision, machine and deployment conditions; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 15 repeated block-entry points less 1.5 upkeep. A legacy controller supports only 4 points of standard drilling-cycle reuse; retain bespoke retract and unsupported programming: 4 minus 1.5 = 2.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain pattern craft, material selection and machine validation while reducing specified arithmetic, copying and cycle entry.
role.ambitious_version: No wider production authority is inferred from these task estimates.
